d: Gangster turned informer, Kenji Gallo, risks all to bring down a New York mafia boss.
A woman's offer of work in Peru leads to incarceration, attempted murder and the ultimate betrayal.
A teenage drug courier is tricked into a more dangerous job than she bargained for in Bolivia  a teen agrees to smuggle drugs from Colombia.

Latasha Madison gets a chance to dance in a club in Thailand, where she falls in love with a man named Phillip  caught with a stash of Phillip's heroin, she is sent to Thailand's notorious "Bangkok Hilton" prison.
A young Londoner gets an exciting offer to work in his dad's bar in Thailand, but when he arrives, he soon discovers a world of temptation that he can't resist, breaking his father's golden rule.
Heather Ebling's trip to Colombia becomes a nightmare when she is arrested for drug smuggling.
A couple, Martin and Gracia, on an anniversary trip in the Philippines is taken hostage, along with 18 others, by an Islamic extremist group.
There is no looking back for John Alite once he joins the mob and becomes a Mafia hitman. However, when everything starts to fall apart, he finds himself torn between his profession and family.
